name: Gravity [2 Player Obby]
desc:
IT'S TIME TO CLIMB LIKE NEVER BEFORE. YOU AND A FRIEND CAN WALK ON WALLS AND GO UPSIDE DOWN THANKS TO SPECIAL POWERS! 

Press E near your friend to pair up with them!

⛰️ Current maximum altitude: 600M 
👍 Thumbs up for future updates!
